description: This file defines a React component for a modal that displays trial benefits information in the Mattermost application, including multiple steps, conditional content, and interactions.

methods.name: TrialBenefitsModal
methods.description: Main React component for the trial benefits modal, managing state, content, and interactions.

methods.name: handleOnClose
methods.description: Handles closing the modal, calling onClose and onExited callbacks.

methods.name: invitePeople
methods.description: Opens the invite people modal and closes the current modal.

methods.name: getSlides
methods.description: Generates slide components for the carousel based on defined steps.

methods.name: trialJustStartedScreen
methods.description: Renders the content for the 'trial just started' state, with conditional buttons and layout.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Determines whether to show the 'trial just started' screen or the carousel of steps.
